gbm_population_evidence.quote: A Phase I-II Study of Niraparib Plus Temozolomide "One Week on, One Week Off" in Patients With Recurrent Isocitrate Dehydrogenase (IDH) Wild Type Glioblastoma and IDH Mutant Gliomas.
Patients with diagnosis of recurrent\\progressive IDH wild-type GBM (WHO 2021, grade 4). All the GBM histological variants are allowed.

candidate_evidence.quote: The study evaluates safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics at recommended phase II dose (RP2D) and preliminary antitumor activity of Niraparib + dd-TMZ "one week on, one week off"

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients with diagnosis of recurrent\\progressive IDH wild-type GBM (WHO 2021, grade 4).

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To evaluate cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) drug concentration of the combination of dd-TMZ and Niraparib given on a 7d ON/7d OFF schedule
To evaluate tissue drug concentration schedule and visualized intra-tumor distribution by mass spectrometry imaging in surgical specimen of the combination of dd-TMZ and Niraparib

role_evidence.quote: Niraparib and Temozolomide in Patients Glioblastoma
Overall, Niraparib can represent an ideal candidate to explore for treatment of malignant gliomas

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: The inhibition of Poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) proteins, normally involved in genomic stability, may rationally improve TMZ efficacy.

role_evidence.quote: Niraparib 100 mg/die + TMZ 100 mg/m2 both given for 7 consecutive days, followed by 7 days OFF, in a cycle of 28 days.

investigator speculate that different schedules and doses of the two drugs (compared to the ones approved in clinical practice) may be explored to improve tolerability preserving the synergistic activity.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, established GBM therapy (dose-dense schedule)

source_quote.quote: Patients with diagnosis of recurrent/progressive IDH mutant gliomas (WHO 2021, grade 2-4). Both astrocytoma and oligodendroglioma may be included.

flag.reason: Record links IDH mutation (2HG, BRCA-ness) to PARP inhibitor sensitivity, but the IDH-mutant cohort is non-GBM and IDH is also the GBM-defining criterion for cohort 1; match could change the primary outcome.

source_quote.quote: Both MGMT methylated and unmethylated patients are allowed.

coder_notes: Two cohorts: recurrent IDH-wildtype GBM (cohort 1) and recurrent IDH-mutant grade 2-4 gliomas (cohort 2); cohorts are not registered arm labels, so biomarker arms left empty. IDH-wildtype for cohort 1 is GBM-defining only; IDH-mutant requirement defines cohort 2 and the detailed description gives a PARP-inhibitor rationale (2HG-induced BRCA-ness), hence coded enrichment and candidate_matched with flag. Temozolomide dose (75 vs 100 mg/m2) differs between dose levels and the dd-TMZ schedule is part of the question, so coded established_therapy_experiment (R2). MGMT listed only as allowed regardless of status (not a selection). Plasma PK (Cmax) also planned.
